aiExplanation.title: Explain results with AI
aiExplanation.description: Generates, only when requested, an overall interpretation and one explanation per chart using the displayed settings, metrics, and aggregates. No original dataset rows are sent.
aiExplanation.localNotice: Provider {{provider}} runs locally. The context stays in this environment.
aiExplanation.externalNotice: Provider {{provider}} is external. If you continue, the displayed aggregate context will be sent to that service.
aiExplanation.unavailable: Configure LLM_PROVIDER and LLM_MODEL to enable this explanation.
aiExplanation.error: The explanation could not be generated. Review the provider configuration and try again.
aiExplanation.disclaimer: Use this explanation as supporting context: verify the metrics before making decisions. The response is not persisted and never triggers actions automatically.

aiChart.title: Explanation for this chart
aiChart.description: The overall analysis appears here. A deep dive sends only this chart's aggregates together with the run context.
aiChart.error: This chart explanation could not be deepened. Check the provider and try again.

aiImprovement.title: Applicable improvement proposal
aiImprovement.description: AI can only select components and parameters supported by ML Advisor. You review every difference before creating a new experiment.
aiImprovement.error: The proposal could not be validated. No configuration was applied; review the provider and generate another proposal.
aiImprovement.noTraining: This action only creates a draft. Training requires another click on the experiment page.
aiImprovement.draftError: The draft could not be created. The source may have changed; generate a new proposal.

home.title: Clear, reproducible machine learning experiments.
home.description: A modular foundation for building, comparing, and understanding tabular models without giving up technical control.

recent.title: Recent experiments
recent.description: Continue a run or review its leading model and primary metric.
recent.error: Recent experiments could not be loaded.
recent.errorDescription: Check that the API is available and try again.
recent.emptyDescription: Import a dataset, define an objective, and choose a workflow mode.

guide.title: What you can do
guide.description: Choose a path. You can use traditional training alone or add AI features when they are useful.
guide.hidden: The starter guide is hidden. You can open it again at any time.

train.title: Train and compare models

understand.title: Understand the results
understand.description: Review metrics and charts for each training run and, when useful, ask AI for a contextual explanation.

decide.title: Evaluate decisions with AI
decide.description: Compare zero-shot models, create semantic variables, and simulate confidence policies with controlled data.

catalog.title: Available training resources
